mechanism: Atomoxetine is a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor that can increase sympathomimetic effects, potentially opposing carvedilol's beta-blocking and alpha-blocking actions, while carvedilol may inhibit CYP2D6-mediated metabolism of atomoxetine.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and ADHD symptom control closely; dose adjustments of either agent may be necessary if efficacy is reduced or cardiovascular effects are compromised.
